title: Projective cofibrancy under enlargement of a finite-pattern universe
statement:
Fix nested Grothendieck universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P=(B,S,\{K_a^{\triangleleft}\to B\})$ be a $\mathcal U$-small categorical pattern of [def-coef-categorical-pattern-fibrancy], with all $2$-simplices scaled and every $K_a$ having finitely many nondegenerate simplices (the empty shape is allowed). Write $\mathsf M_{P,\mathcal W}$ for the marked pattern model category of [lem-coef-categorical-pattern-model-calculus] in universe $\mathcal W$, and $\iota$ for inclusion of the smaller marked simplicial objects into the larger ones. Use the common generators, weak equivalences and fibrant replacements of [lem-coef-finite-pattern-universe-comparison].

Let $I$ be a $\mathcal U$-small fibrant simplicial category: it has a small set of objects, small simplicial mapping sets that are Kan complexes, and associative unital simplicial composition. Give the enriched functor categories $\mathsf M_{P,\mathcal W}^I$ the projective model structures of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-coherent-diagrams]. The inclusion $\iota^I$ sends every projective cofibration between $\mathcal U$-small enriched diagrams to a projective cofibration in the larger diagram category. In particular, if $QF\to F$ is a projectively cofibrant replacement in the smaller category, then the same arrow is a projectively cofibrant replacement in the larger category. It also sends every projectively cofibrant-fibrant diagram to a projectively cofibrant-fibrant diagram. Here a projectively cofibrant replacement is an objectwise trivial fibration with projectively cofibrant source; projective fibrations and weak equivalences are objectwise.

source.place: Proposition A.3.3.2 and Remarks A.3.3.4-A.3.3.5, printed pp.869-870 (PDF pp.887-888): projective enriched structures and free-diagram cells. The universe-enlargement consequence is agent-written from this cellular description and the common finite-pattern generators, not a separately numbered theorem. No Stacks tag states this enriched model-category result.
